subject: Bash
reason: The command made _smoke.mjs with a heredoc, ran it, and then deleted it. That is a local change that you can undo, so the tier is warning. Two bugs caused the card. A node -p step earlier on the same line made the cat heredoc body count as code, so its text was scanned. Also, the heredoc strip removed the closing line, so all later steps were joined into one step. That second bug also hid real risks: after a data heredoc, echo a; rm -rf ~/important got warning and no card. Now those steps get high_stakes.
